subject.title: feat(feishu): native Markdown for inbound content_v2 & outbound tag:md

question: Should native `tag:md` posts replace the established Feishu auto-card and configured table-conversion behavior for existing installations?
rationale: Both existing behaviors are user-facing compatibility contracts, and choosing the permanent outbound carrier and upgrade policy requires product intent rather than a mechanical code repair.

options.title: Split inbound and preserve outbound
options.body: Land the compatible `content_v2` parser separately and retain existing auto-card routing and table conversion until outbound policy is decided.

options.title: Add an explicit native mode
options.body: Keep current defaults while adding a clearly documented opt-in mode for native `tag:md` delivery with focused fresh-install and upgrade tests.

options.title: Approve a breaking default change
options.body: Adopt native posts as the new default only with explicit deprecation or migration treatment and carrier-identifying desktop and mobile proof.

recommendation.title: Split inbound and preserve outbound
recommendation.body: Land the compatible `content_v2` parser separately and retain existing auto-card routing and table conversion until outbound policy is decided.

likelyOwner.reason: The permanent carrier decision most directly intersects the default streaming-card and reply-dispatch behavior introduced in this contributor's merged Feishu work.
